name.local: JICベンチャー・グロース・インベストメンツ株式会社

size.raw: ¥200 billion, of which ¥170bn growth / ¥30bn early-stage (¥15bn earmarked for life science)

strategy.thesis: JIC-VGI is the growth-investment arm of Japan's government-affiliated Industrial Innovation Investment Corporation (JIC). Its second fund (¥200bn) allocates the bulk of capital (¥170bn) to expansion/growth/later-stage rounds from Series B onward across priority sectors, and separately ring-fences ¥15bn of early-stage capital specifically for life science alongside deep tech, giving it a dedicated growth-stage pre-IPO pool for Japanese biotech/medtech companies.

summary.en: Government-affiliated (JIC group) growth-equity investor that treats life science as one of a handful of designated priority sectors, deploying growth/late-stage capital (from Series B) plus a dedicated early-stage life-science bucket in its ¥200bn second fund.
summary.local: 産業革新投資機構（JIC）グループのグロース投資会社。ライフサイエンスをディープテック等と並ぶ重点分野に位置付け、2号ファンド（総額2000億円）でシリーズB以降のグロース投資に1700億円、アーリー領域（うちライフサイエンスに150億円）を配分している。

sources.supports: Fund sizes (¥120bn Fund1, ¥200bn Fund2 with ¥170bn growth / ¥30bn early incl. ¥15bn life science), life science as priority sector, Series-B-onward growth focus
sources.quote: VGF2 (fund size ¥200 billion): Growth segment ¥170 billion; Early-stage segment ¥30 billion, of which ¥15 billion dedicated to life science. Primary objective involves deploying capital to advance mid-stage and later growth, while establishing dedicated early-stage buckets for strategic priority sectors including life science.

Life science is one of several designated priority sectors (alongside deep tech/AI), not JIC-VGI's exclusive focus, so it is included here for its dedicated growth-stage life-science capital pool rather than as a life-science-only fund.

funds.name: 大和日台バイオベンチャー2号投資事業有限責任組合

strategy.thesis: Daiwa Securities Group-affiliated, bio-exclusive VC that is Japan's largest specialist life-science fund by AUM among sector-focused VCs; concentrates on Series B/Series C and pre-IPO later-stage rounds for unlisted drug-discovery and regenerative-medicine ventures in Japan and Taiwan, providing hands-on clinical-development, IP and business-development support.

lifesci.science_platform_notes: Hands-on support drawing on clinical development, IP and business-development expertise and a network spanning research institutions, drug-discovery ventures and pharmaceutical companies.

summary.en: Daiwa-affiliated, bio-only VC and Japan's largest specialist life-science fund by capital under management; focuses on Series B/C and pre-IPO later-stage rounds in unlisted Japanese and Taiwanese drug-discovery and regenerative-medicine ventures.
summary.local: 大和証券グループ系のバイオ特化型ベンチャーキャピタルで、特化型VCとして国内最大級の資金を運用。日本・台湾の創薬・再生医療系未上場ベンチャーのシリーズB・C、上場前のレイターステージ投資を中心とする。

strategy.thesis: Mizuho Bank/Mizuho Capital jointly run a dedicated life-science growth fund targeting 成長企業 (growth-stage companies) in drug discovery, biotech, regenerative medicine/cell therapy and medical devices, pairing capital with continued hands-on business and financial support pre- and post-listing.

summary.en: Megabank-affiliated VC whose ¥5bn 'Mizuho Life Science Fund No.1' (jointly funded with Mizuho Bank, launched Jan 2020) targets growth-stage Japanese drug-discovery, regenerative-medicine and medtech companies pre-IPO, with continued management/financial support after listing.

funds.name: 三菱UFJライフサイエンス1号ファンド

strategy.thesis: Runs Japan's largest private life-science-specialist fund lineup, investing over holding periods of up to ~12 years across university-origin drug-discovery ventures, pharma carve-outs, and direct risk-capital for pharma R&D projects — a horizon that necessarily carries positions through Series B/C and growth/pre-clinical-to-clinical-stage rounds ahead of IPO or trade sale.

summary.en: MUFG's dedicated venture-capital arm has run consecutive life-science funds since its ¥10bn 'MUFJ Life Science Fund No.1' (Feb 2017), described as among Japan's largest private life-science-specialist fund programs, backing university-origin drug discovery, pharma carve-outs and pharma R&D risk capital across up to ~12-year holding periods that extend into growth/late clinical stages pre-IPO.
summary.local: 三菱UFJキャピタルは2017年2月設立の「三菱ＵＦＪライフサイエンス1号ファンド」（総額100億円）以来、ライフサイエンス特化ファンドを継続的に組成しており、国内最大級の民間ライフサイエンス特化ファンドとされる。アカデミア創薬、製薬カーブアウト、製薬プロジェクトへのリスクマネー供給を最長約12年の投資期間で行う。
